records.summary: This paper reports a customizable CRISPR ribonucleoprotein delivery tool, dubbed RIDE, for the treatment of Huntington’s disease in mice, non-human primates and patients’ iPSC neurons.

records.title: Nanopore discrimination of rare earth elements
records.summary: Here the authors show that Mycobacterium smegmatis porin A modified with nitrilotriacetic acid achieves direct and simultaneous discrimination of rare earth elements, suggesting the potential use of nanopore sensing in geological exploration.

records.title: Spin–valley protected Kramers pair in bilayer graphene
records.summary: A tunable quantum dot device in Bernal bilayer graphene possesses a spin–valley relaxation time of 38 s at millikelvin temperatures.

records.title: Multivalent effect enables efficient and stable deep-blue perovskite LEDs
records.summary: A distinctive multivalent-effect immobilization strategy fundamentally stabilizes the structure of deep-blue reduced-dimensional perovskite emitters and enhances excitonic radiative recombination. Using this effect, the efficiency and stability bottlenecks of deep-blue perovskite LEDs are overcome.

records.title: Spin-torque-driven gigahertz magnetization dynamics in the non-collinear antiferromagnet Mn 3 Sn
records.summary: An optically induced spin current pulse induces gigahertz magnetization dynamics in Mn 3 Sn with a spin coherence length of approximately 15 nm, which is longer than in ferromagnets.

records.title: Nature-inspired platform nanotechnology for RNA delivery to myeloid cells and their bone marrow progenitors
records.summary: In this study, the authors present optimization and efficacy testing of apolipoprotein-based lipid nanoparticles for delivering various nucleic acid therapeutics in vivo to immune cells and their progenitors in the bone marrow.

records.title: Resolving polarization switching pathways of sliding ferroelectricity in trilayer 3R-MoS 2
records.summary: The work studies the switchable excitonic response in trilayer 3R-MoS 2 and shows that the polarization switching pathway in multilayer sliding ferroelectrics results from interactions between domain walls, pinning centres and free-carrier screening.

records.title: Multivalent-effect immobilization of reduced-dimensional perovskites for efficient and spectrally stable deep-blue light-emitting diodes
records.summary: A multivalent immobilization strategy uses hydrogen, ionic and coordination bonds that interact with perovskite, enabling deep-blue perovskite LEDs to achieve an external quantum efficiency of 15.36% at 459 nm.

records.title: Bruno Scrosati (1937–2024)
Tracking nonlinear conversion of light in van der Waals waveguides
records.summary: Far-field stroboscopic scattering microscopy tracks the propagation of both fundamental and second-harmonic waves within van der Waals waveguides, allowing parameter-free determination of phase-matching conditions.

records.title: Salt-in-presalt electrolyte solutions for high-potential non-aqueous sodium metal batteries
records.summary: The specific energy and cycle life of rechargeable non-aqueous Na-based batteries are influenced by the type of electrolyte used. Here the authors propose a sulfonyl imide-rich electrolyte solution to improve the energy content and life span of various Na-based batteries.

records.title: Nanotech powers on-chip intelligence
records.summary: Nanotechnology fosters energy-efficient devices that significantly boost on-chip performance for faster, more powerful AI, while also supporting dense integration of sensing and computing, reducing power consumption for advanced on-chip intelligence.

records.title: ON–OFF nanopores for optical control of transmembrane ionic communication
records.summary: Here the authors present photo-nanopores in which α-haemolysin monomers are modified with arylazopyrazoles, allowing quantitative photoswitching of the transmembrane ionic current, analogous to electronic diodes and light-tunable resistors in response to light.

records.title: Dipolar wavevector interference induces a polar skyrmion lattice in strained BiFeO 3 films
records.summary: In ultrathin BiFeO 3 films on LaAlO 3 , compressive strain of the substrate induces a polar skyrmion lattice with nanometre periodicity.

records.title: Chemistry, manufacturing and controls strategies for using novel excipients in lipid nanoparticles
records.summary: This Perspective discusses some of the challenges that pharmaceutical companies face in the use of lipid excipients at each stage of development, and proposes recommendations on how to streamline regulatory expectations.

records.title: Remote epitaxial crystalline perovskites for ultrahigh-resolution micro-LED displays
records.summary: Remote epitaxial growth of continuous crystalline perovskite thin films is demonstrated. These films can be seamlessly integrated into micro-LEDs with an ultrahigh resolution of 4 μm pixel size.

records.title: Spatiotemporal imaging of nonlinear optics in van der Waals waveguides
records.summary: An optical method images nonlinear optical processes in waveguides with femtosecond and nanometre precision. The approach is used to achieve phase-matched second-harmonic generation in 3R-MoS 2 waveguides.

records.title: Anomalous Hall spin current drives self-generated spin–orbit torque in a ferromagnet
records.summary: An anomalous Hall spin current in a ferromagnetic conductor generates a giant spin–orbit torque with unique angular symmetry. This discovery enables a spin torque nano-oscillator with potential applications in neuromorphic signal processing.

records.title: Ferroelectricity with concomitant Coulomb screening in van der Waals heterostructures
records.summary: Sliding ferroelectricity with finite conductance can yield ferroelectric hysteresis with concomitant Coulomb screening in monolayer graphene containing van der Waals heterostructures of various compositions.

records.title: AND-gated protease-activated nanosensors for programmable detection of anti-tumour immunity
records.summary: Here the authors present cyclic peptide-based AND-gated nanosensors to detect concomitant protease activity. These nanosensors improve detection specificity during immune checkpoint blockade therapy compared with off-tumour anti-viral immunity in a mouse model.

records.title: Autophagosomes coated in situ with nanodots act as personalized cancer vaccines
records.summary: Cancer vaccine is a powerful cancer immunotherapy strategy. Here autophagosomes coated with nanodots in situ in tumours serve as personalized cancer vaccines, effectively activating anti-cancer immune responses in vivo.

records.title: Ferrimagnetic Heusler tunnel junctions with fast spin-transfer torque switching enabled by low magnetization
records.summary: Owing to its very low magnetization, small currents suffice to write a ferrimagnetic Heusler memory layer in complementary metal–oxide–semiconductor-compatible magnetic tunnel via spin-transfer torque, which can help in shrinking the memory cell and extending the application space for magnetic random-access memory.

records.title: Measuring age-dependent viscoelasticity of organelles, cells and organisms with time-shared optical tweezer microrheology
records.summary: An optical-tweezer-based nanorheometer is developed to quantify the viscoelasticity of biomolecular condensates and intracellular compartments in vivo during aging and mutations that cause nuclear envelopathies in a Caenorhabditis elegans model.

records.title: Momentum tunnelling between nanoscale liquid flows
records.summary: A liquid flow can cross a solid wall, at odds with classical hydrodynamics, thanks to couplings between the liquid’s fluctuations and the electronic excitations of the solid inducing a momentum tunnelling.

records.title: Negative memory capacitance and ionic filtering effects in asymmetric nanopores
records.summary: In conical nanopores, the transient current generated by disturbing the ionic flux equilibrium is slow to respond to changes in the ionic state due to Warburg-like impedance, producing ‘ionic filters’ and negative capacitance with memory.

records.title: Half-wave nanolasers and intracellular plasmonic lasing particles
records.summary: A metal–semiconductor structure as small as 170 nm in diameter emits lasing light from the lowest-order plasmonic mode across a broad spectral range in the infrared.
